text:
ali: Heads-up: UX asks we show per-tenant SLOs + notify routing in console. Do we want the notify rules to live under the SLO resource or a separate 'notify_policy' service? Looking for backend/input shape thoughts. cc @maria @kevin

maria: leaning separate resource. SLO = metric+threshold; notification = policy+routing. Separate makes reuse easier (alerts can reference policy).

kevin: agreed separate. also need sampling + dedupe params per policy. otherwise noisy tenants will break dashboards.

ops-bot: Incident 4872: alert spike for tenant-42 routed to oncall - suppressed by existing global mute.

sam: UI note: we can add inline preview of expected notifications for a given tenant with simulated signals. small perf hit but useful for admins.

ali: important: console must show which policy applied and fallback when capacity-constrained (e.g., route -> secondary email or webhook).

maria: from API POV: propose POST /notify_policies and SLO { notify_policy_id: '...' } OR SLOs reference policy by selector (label set). Which is easier for rollout?

kevin: selector approach is flexible but harder to reason for non-technical admins. id reference is clearer. maybe support both? id primary, selector optional.

julia: we also need rate-limits/quota per policy (notifications per minute) and backoff window. Customers asked for per-route quotas.

sam: example payload:
```json
{
  "policy_id": "np-123",
  "destinations": ["team-email","secondary-webhook"],
  "dedupe_window_s": 300,
  "sampling": {"type":"threshold","pct": 100},
  "rate_limit_per_min": 10
}
```

maria: love payload. minor: rename sampling.type->mode, add allowlist/denylist for tenants.

kevin: ops debate: do we dedupe at producer (runtime) or central notify service? runtime has context to combine events but single point-of-failure if it's at producer.

ali: operationally prefer central notify service + idempotency keys from runtime. runtime should attach context (event_hash, tenant_id).

ops-bot: Note: will add telemetry hooks: notify.sent, notify.skipped_reason, notify.deduped to event stream.

maria: UI: show sample 'last 24h' notification volume and a 'noise score' computed from sampling/duplicates. Would help tune thresholds.

ali: action items: kevin to prototype API shape, sam to wire mock preview UI, julia to spec rate-limit config, maria to update schema proposal. I'll schedule 30m sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:
